# CSSEBets

> CSSEBets is a prediction market and arcade platform: trade live markets on football, Formula 1 and UFC, or play provably fair arcade games from one wallet.

Markets are priced from a global odds feed and updated in near real-time. Every stake, settlement and payout is auditable in the player's wallet history. Arcade games are server-authoritative and provably fair.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What CSSEBets is, live markets and featured fixtures.
- [About](/about): How the platform works and who it's for.
- [Help & FAQ](/faq): Funding a wallet, placing bets, and getting paid.
- [Community](/community): Leagues, referrals and live platform activity.
- [Performance](/performance): Settlement speed, payout timelines and platform health.
- [Brand](/brand): Logo system, colour palette and typography guidelines.
